_comment: Permissions for mxa projects. No defaultMode here on purpose: the mode is the person's, set to auto in ~/.claude/settings.json by mxa-setup, and a project file cannot set auto (Claude Code ignores it there) but would override theirs with anything else. The allow list is short on purpose. In auto mode an allow rule resolves before the classifier sees the action, so every entry here is a command that runs unreviewed: only the suite's own tools and commands that build or record work belong, never one that deletes, pushes, deploys or installs an arbitrary package. Those go to the classifier in auto mode and prompt in Manual, which is the right cost for each. The list earns its place in Manual mode, where auto is unavailable, and in cloud sessions. ls, cat, ps and lsof are not listed because Claude Code's built-in read-only set already covers them. Copied into each project at .claude/settings.json by mxa-new-project, and merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by mxa-setup.
